g1_camera_derived_optics.image_center_convention: Use the Warp ray caster pixel-center convention; do not assume this equals a calibrated hardware intrinsic matrix.

selected_or_inherited_baseline.note: These are simulation starting settings, not measurements or values implied by kinematics.
selected_or_inherited_baseline.torque_equation: clip(Kp * (q_home + 0.25 * clip(a, -100, 100) - q) - Kd * dq, -effort, effort)
selected_or_inherited_baseline.target_position_clipping: Unmodified G1 joint-position action term; no position-target clamp. Generated simulation models use symmetric waist-yaw hard stops.
selected_or_inherited_baseline.friction_mapping_note: PhysX joint friction is zero to match the loaded G1 IsaacGym asset; MuJoCo Coulomb frictionloss remains independently set to 0.3 Nm.
selected_or_inherited_baseline.initial_upper_body_reference: Retargeted X2 ACCAD arms, standardized to 10 seconds
selected_or_inherited_baseline.symmetry_scope: PPO flat and terrain experts; DAgger unchanged
selected_or_inherited_baseline.joint_limit_override_note: Apply only to generated training URDF/MuJoCo and runtime configuration; source vendor limits are preserved in derived.dofs.
selected_or_inherited_baseline.symmetry_implementation: Unmodified G1 PPO and SymmetryUtils; no sample masking or custom distributed loss handling.
selected_or_inherited_baseline.foot_edge_offsets_note: Approximation derived from the lowest support-sphere center extents; excludes raised toe spheres, ignores the 5 mm radius, and uses existing base-oriented reward sampling.
